fixed_region_provenance: Station x tags refer to physical beam axes; open/closed/endpoint atomic conventions all retained. Smooth window has unit peak and zero value/slope at boundaries. Native continuous density and external nodal atoms are not pointwise interchangeable.
root_provenance: No root station equation. Beam first5 directly grounded; sixth component remains free equilibrium. Positive-x interpolation can allocate shell interface loads to fixed root nodes. Root G alone is not ground: the recorded root interface term must be added. Do not identify this partition with the old root connection into a fixed shell.
row_units: Three position gaps m/two rotation gaps rad; strong nodal mu in N/Nm, not native weak multiplier density N/m or Nm/m.
sign_provenance: G=assembled global element resisting covector; L=applied load; C^T mu=L-G on each free beam station; connection resisting=C^T mu, exerted=-C^T mu; ground=(G+C^T mu-L) restricted to prescribed components. Raw nodeReaction unused.
